meta.notes: Optional preset for a marketing and sales-focused fleet. Replace {{MAIN_REPO}}, {{CRM_URL}}, and {{KANBAN_URL}} during installation. Remove this file if you do not need a growth/marketing fleet.

team.name: Scout
team.roleDesc: Monitors industry news and competitor activity to identify high-value opportunities. The front-line eyes of the fleet.

team.name: Echo
team.roleDesc: Drafts high-engagement posts, suggests content for video platforms, and manages the social calendar. Amplifies the brand voice.

team.name: Closer
team.roleDesc: Inputs leads into the CRM, drafts personalized outreach emails, and coordinates follow-ups with humans-in-the-loop.

projects.title: Lead Pipeline (CRM)
projects.summary: Autonomous lead discovery and CRM synchronization. A fleet-managed prototype for inbound pipeline automation.

projects.title: Content Calendar
projects.summary: Autonomous content planning. Echo suggests the posts, the human publishes.
